title: Short Password
description: SwiftCargo's crew requires an 8-character minimum on passwords. Confirm the registration form's guardrail is actually enforced server-side, not just on the client.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/register with a body containing a 7-character password (and a valid email and role) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR. The same request with an 8-character password and a fresh email returns 201.
hints: role must be one of admin, dispatcher, driver, or customer — an invalid role fails validation too, so keep it valid while isolating the password length.
Use a fresh, never-registered email for the 8-character case, or you'll get a 409 conflict instead of the 201 you're expecting.
